Formula For each retained parent p, C[p] is the source table rows assigned to p by truncated keys: counts[p] = sum(c in C[p]) childCounts[c] modulo 2^32; sums[p] = sum(c in C[p]) childSums[c] with signed 64-bit saturation. The representable signed interval is [-2^63, 2^63-1], including exact -2^63 with a clear flag; positive overflow is replaced by 2^63-1 and negative overflow by -(2^63-1); status.sumOverflow propagates source sum loss and local saturation independently of count completeness. No re-quantization occurs; sumValues decodes the signed sum with the existing sumScale. Minimums/maximums reduce the matching source extremes. Source rows must be at sourceResolution. Final overflow reports only destination capacity drops; source overflow and candidateOverflow propagate as candidateOverflow, making requiredCount a lower bound on the full parent requirement.

The representable signed interval is [-2^63, 2^63-1], including exact -2^63 with a clear flag; positive overflow is replaced by 2^63-1 and negative overflow by -(2^63-1); status.sumOverflow propagates source sum loss and local saturation independently of count completeness. No re-quantization occurs; sumValues decodes the signed sum with the existing sumScale. Minimums/maximums reduce the matching source extremes. Source rows must be at sourceResolution. Final overflow reports only destination capacity drops; source overflow and candidateOverflow propagate as candidateOverflow, making requiredCount a lower bound on the full parent requirement.
